dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 20, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**TWIN TAKEDOWN: TWINS CRUSHED BY GUARDIANS, YANKEES TAKE DOWN PIRATES**

Yesterday's MLB action saw some explosive performances across the league. The Cleveland Guardians dominated the Minnesota Twins 13-4, with Petey Halpin leading the charge, going 3-for-5 with two home runs and three RBIs. On the mound, Tanner Bibee delivered a strong start, allowing just two earned runs over six innings. In a separate contest, the New York Yankees took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-5, thanks in part to Jazz Chisholm Jr.'s two home runs and five RBIs. Wilber Dotel was nearly unhittable in relief, striking out five batters over three scoreless innings.

The Tampa Bay Rays continued their winning ways, defeating the Toronto Blue Jays 7-1 behind Dylan Cease's six strong innings. Nick Fortes provided the offense, going 2-for-4 with a home run and an RBI. The Boston Red Sox edged out the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 in a back-and-forth affair, with Christian Encarnacion-Strand hitting a two-run homer and Payton Tolle striking out nine over 5.2 innings.

In other results, the Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the Los Angeles Dodgers 10-7, with Trea Turner going 3-for-5 with two home runs and five RBIs. Cristopher Sánchez earned the win, allowing just three earned runs over 5.1 innings. The Atlanta Braves took down the San Diego Padres 3-2, with Manny Machado hitting a solo homer and Bradgley Rodriguez striking out two in a scoreless inning.
